utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it—keep me posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do—I’ll check in once I’ve got the plan and timing nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli—just shoot me the plan and timing when you’ve got it, and I’ll check it between stops.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo — I’m juggling a lot, but I’m in for the repair drive. Just tell me the time and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — Saturday at 10 by the community shed. Bring any basic tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Saturday at 10 by the shed. I’ll bring a few basic tools and be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we sure the repair drive is actually happening, and do we know when?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it’s happening, but I’d rather confirm the date and who’s bringing tools before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, can we confirm the date first, and who’s actually bringing the tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to bring my toolbox, but I can still help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem—we can still use an extra pair of hands. I’ve got a basic kit here, so maybe help me sort the screws and patch supplies?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely—just point me where you want things, and I’ll sort the screws and patch supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What part of the repair drive are we locking down first, Noah—the list of fixes, the volunteers, or the timing?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, timing first, I think—if we don’t pin down the day, the volunteers and fix list are kind of floating.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, let’s pin down the day first—are we deciding between Saturday and Sunday, or do you already have a specific date in mind?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries—it’s going well, actually. A few folks from different blocks showed up, so we’ve got a nice little crew going.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’s great to hear—want me to jump in wherever you need an extra pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive—tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear, Sam—I’ve got a few wobbly chairs and a busted lamp folks are bringing by, and I can lend my tools for the day.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect—I can start on the chairs and then take a look at the lamp once we’ve got a good workspace set up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted at the community center lot this afternoon—do you want me to confirm the exact start time too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes please—if you can confirm the start time, I can plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ve got the community center lot noted already, and I’ll confirm the exact start time for you next.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Heard the repair drive’s picking up steam, Quinn—folks on Maple already dropped off a good stack of tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great news—I’ll swing by Cedar and Pine this afternoon and let everyone know to bring their busted lamps and radios over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect—tell them we’ve got Mara setting up a little sorting table, so it’ll be easy to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and who’s covering each job?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know a couple pieces so far—Sam said he’s handling the bike repairs, and Lila’s bringing tools. I should check with the others one by one before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then check with them today and send me a full list—who’s doing what, and what still doesn’t have coverage.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, there’s a repair drive coming up soon—I’ve been telling folks so we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—I’d only heard bits and pieces about it. When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s happening this Saturday afternoon, and I’ve been letting everyone know so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized, and I’d love to sync on what tools and volunteers we’ve got so far.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning, Rosa. I can help keep track quietly—I've got a basic toolkit, but I’m a bit limited on time right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli—that’s still a big help. If you can send me a quick list of what’s in your toolkit, I’ll match it with the volunteer gaps and keep the rest light on your end.
